optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Data Pipeline Engineer, Developer Tools Platform

professionalSummary.text: Maintained build-event ingestion pipelines and their schemas, including adding schema versioning to ensure older event formats continued to load after producer changes.
professionalSummary.witness: Maintained the build-event ingestion pipelines (Kafka consumers writing to the events warehouse) and their schemas, adding schema versioning so that older event formats kept loading after producer changes.

professionalSummary.text: Maintained daily aggregate jobs that roll build, test and deployment events into per-repository tables for engineering dashboards.
professionalSummary.witness: Maintained the daily aggregate jobs that roll build, test and deployment events into the per-repository tables behind the engineering dashboards.

professionalSummary.text: Reduced daily aggregate completion time from 3 hours 40 minutes to 1 hour 10 minutes after releasing an incremental rewrite, measured against the published pipeline baseline over thirty days.
professionalSummary.witness: The daily aggregate's completion time dropped from 3 hours 40 minutes to 1 hour 10 minutes after the incremental rewrite was released, measured over the following thirty days in the pipeline monitoring dashboard against the published baseline of 3 hours 40 minutes.

professionalSummary.text: Coordinated schema and job changes with dashboard and platform teams during weekly data syncs, with platform lead approval of warehouse changes and dashboard team confirmation of table contracts.
professionalSummary.witness: Coordinated schema and job changes with the dashboard team and the platform team in the weekly data sync; the platform lead approved warehouse changes and the dashboard team confirmed the table contracts.

professionalSummary.text: Documented lineage, known limitations, and hand-over conditions for pipeline releases, including source topics, incremental logic, late event limitations, and on-call hand-over items.
professionalSummary.witness: Wrote the lineage note for the aggregate jobs, listing source topics, the incremental logic, the known limitation that late events beyond 48 hours were not re-aggregated, and the hand-over items for on-call.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Pipeline monitoring dashboard export showing daily completion time for sixty days, baseline line, and release markers; lineage note for aggregate jobs with job run identifiers as verification trail.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the pipeline monitoring dashboard export (daily completion time for sixty days, baseline line, release marker) and the lineage note for the aggregate jobs, with the job run identifiers as a verification trail.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's maintenance of pipelines, schema versioning, daily aggregate jobs, completion time reduction, coordination with teams, and documentation of lineage. The materials do not establish the candidate's ownership of the entire pipeline lifecycle, leadership beyond coordination, or specific metrics beyond the completion time reduction.
